items.summary: Financial recommendation: approve containment and authorize no discretionary spend, new monetization investment, or forecast-based expansion this cycle. Revenue support is insufficient: Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21, showing 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The full $4.92 is aggregate under tracking ID other; site-attributed commission is $0. Do not report aggregate commission as site revenue. Contribution margin and ROI are not calculable because site-level revenue attribution, infrastructure costs, labor/change costs, and fixed costs are unavailable. Cost-to-learn is also not calculable because there is no attributable financial outcome or comparable experiment result. AI usage is measurable only for 2026-10-01: 16 calls across 4 sites at $2.2785467 total; fleet-wide AI cost is unknown because coverage is 4 of 38 expected sites. Infrastructure spend, monthly budget exposure, revenue target, revenue floor, and marketing budget are unknown because the brief provides no values. Minimum measurement needed: dated site/content identifiers, affiliate clicks, ordered items, shipped items, commission, direct change cost, AI cost, infrastructure allocation, and experiment exposure/outcome data reconciled to the same window. Preserve only the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA request after one delivery slot is released and site overlap is cleared; use the 2026-09-21 baseline of 61 clicks, 0 ordered items, 0 shipped items, and $0 site-attributed commission. Accept on measurement readiness, not forecast revenue; classify financial results as unknown if attribution remains unavailable.

Retain the current finance boundary for the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement. After capacity clears, measure affiliate clicks, ordered items, shipped items, site-attributed commission, direct change cost, and available AI or infrastructure allocation for 14 days or 100 relevant new impressions/clicks. Require registered site tracking IDs for every new affiliate link. Do not assign aggregate provider earnings to a site or claim contribution margin, ROI, payback, or causal lift without site-specific revenue and cost evidence.
